# Vendored libraries and fonts

The web interface ships its libraries and fonts inside the package, so that it
works on an edge server without internet access.

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
|------|---------|---------|---------|
| `htmx.min.js` | [htmx](https://htmx.org) | 2.0.4 | BSD Zero Clause |
| `codemirror.min.js`, `codemirror.min.css`, `codemirror-yaml.min.js` | [CodeMirror](https://codemirror.net/5/) | 5.65.16 | MIT |
| `yasgui.min.js`, `yasgui.min.css` | [Yasgui](https://github.com/TriplyDB/Yasgui) | 4.2.28 | MIT |
| `cytoscape.min.js` | [Cytoscape.js](https://js.cytoscape.org) | 3.34.3 | MIT |
| `../fonts/ibm-plex-*.woff2` | [IBM Plex](https://github.com/IBM/plex) | 6.x | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
